metadata.description: Chi (side-chain) dihedral angle atom definitions per residue, used to compute rotamer torsion angles (chi1-chi5) from PDB coordinates. Each entry is a dash-separated string of 4 atom names defining the dihedral, in order.
metadata.residue_note: Only residues with a rotatable side chain beyond CB are included; ALA, GLY are omitted as they have no chi angles (VAL/THR/SER etc. have only chi1).
metadata.angle_definition: For a dihedral 'A-B-C-D', the angle is measured around the B-C bond, computed from the coordinates of A, B, C, D in that order (e.g. via the standard dihedral/torsion formula).
